summary: Repository IGNITE 17-to-8 coarse remap contract with native ontology, site/specimen conditioning, and protected unannotated/background pixels.

annotation_traits: multi-center lung-cancer ROIs include primary and metastatic sites
multiple specimen types and scanners are represented
repository masks collapse the public native ontology into eight canonical classes
semantic_limitations: The repository eight-class profile is a lossy remap of the public native ontology and requires an exact remap digest.
Canonical Stroma, Normal epithelium, Immune infiltrate, and Other tissue can each combine distinct native structures.
Primary lung and metastatic-site morphology and annotation prevalence must not share unstratified thresholds.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound profile_required_provenance execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: The repository currently lacks a versioned standalone 17-to-8 mapping artifact; production use remains blocked.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound background_seed_protection execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: Collapsed zero does not retain the native distinction between unannotated and background.

rules.claim: Enforce the compiler-bound profile_required_provenance execution invariant.
rules.required_observation: Use only the typed observation_authority records; no unannotated histologic structure observation is authorized.
known_limitations: Primary/metastatic status is not yet a required CaseContext field and may need to be carried inside provenance.

rules.claim: Do not treat a canonical coarse class as a single histologic structure after native-label collapse.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A pixel-aligned retained native mask may support a more specific reviewed rule.
counterexamples: Using alveolar tissue as desmoplastic stroma.
Using bronchial epithelium as a generic tumor expansion substrate.
Treating erythrocytes as a vascular wall.
expected_morphology: The selected band is visibly compatible with the specific requested boundary change.
forbidden_morphology: Crossing airspace, bronchial lining, cartilage, muscle, or foreign-site tissue under a generic canonical label.
known_limitations: H&E resolution and staining quality constrain visual subtype recovery.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.

rules.claim: Do not use coarse-mask morphology to bridge separate tumor components, fill air/luminal holes, or split a selected epithelial component.
rules.required_observation: Counterfactual histology may be inspected only after generation in reader-only QA; this fact is unavailable to execution selection or veto.
exceptions: A dedicated topology-changing primitive with site-specific review.
counterexamples: Closing alveolar spaces inside a lepidic region.
Merging tumor across a bronchial lumen.
Creating a detached tumor island in collapsed Other tissue.
expected_morphology: The candidate deforms one existing tissue interface without repairing unrelated coarse-mask gaps.
forbidden_morphology: New islands, bridges, filled lumina/airspaces, or component splits/merges.
known_limitations: The coarse profile cannot deterministically identify every airspace or lumen; critic veto remains required.
Reader-only pathology facts are excluded from the execution knowledge bundle.
